name: DIW-uMEX Robota Precision 1.4 nozzle
extruder_variant_list: Direct Drive Standard,Direct Drive High Flow,Direct Drive Extra High Flow
machine_end_gcode:
G92 E0.0
G1 {if max_layer_z < max_print_height}Z{z_offset+min(max_layer_z+30, max_print_height)}{endif} F1500 ; move print head up safely
G1 X0 Y0 F3000 ; park print head
machine_start_gcode:
G90 ; use absolute coordinates
M82 ; extruder absolute mode
G92 E0.0
; initial load
G1 X205.0 E19 F300 ; lowered speed to prevent syringe pump stalling
G1 Y1.6
G1 X5.0 E19 F300
G92 E0.0
; intro line
G1 Y2.0 Z0.2 F1000
G1 X65.0 E9.0 F300
G1 X105.0 E12.5 F300
G92 E0.0
